title: Kush, a synthetic and highly addictive drug, devastates Sierra Leone and Liberia
subhead: 'Africa under the influence' (2/6). Sold at a low price, kush causes rapid addiction and severe, often fatal, injuries. Photographer Gaël Turine traveled to Freetown and Monrovia to document the destruction wrought by this new synthetic drug among young people in Sierra Leone and Liberia.

title: 'Banning social media before age 15 transforms the conditions for exercising freedom of expression'
